milestone: M7 — Tina CMS wiring (pulled forward ahead of M6 by client ruling)
config: tina/config.ts mirrors src/content.config.ts for journeys, destinations, cities, posts, testimonials, siteSettings — camelCase names identical; Zod remains the validator
media: repo-based, /public/uploads/ (locked). Image fields map /uploads/<f> (editor) ↔ ../../../public/uploads/<f> (file); verified: a file in public/uploads referenced that way builds 13 AVIF/WebP variants
editing_mode: forms-based for every collection at /admin. Visual editing deliberately absent: it needs output:'server', forbidden by the locked static stack

smoke_tests.phone_change_via_real_form: PASS — saved through the /admin form (23 settings keys preserved), built, present on the homepage and every footer
smoke_tests.journey_field_via_real_form: PASS — signatureFeature saved, Zod-clean build, present on the page
smoke_tests.create_article_end_to_end: PASS — createPosts wrote an Astro-valid .md; build accepted it (draft, so unrendered)
smoke_tests.image_upload: PASS — POST /media/upload/<file> landed in public/uploads; a settings entry referencing it built 13 optimised variants served from /_astro/
smoke_tests.invalid_entry: PASS — phoneHref 'abc' → build refused naming the field; dist/ untouched (site stays up)
smoke_tests.api_partial_update_caveat: updateSiteSettings with partial params REPLACES the settings object — an API-only hazard; the form submits the full document. Recorded so nobody scripts partial updates

bugs_found_by_the_smoke_tests: ui.parse/format called .startsWith on the raw field value; for image LIST fields that is an array (gallery: []), which threw 'value.startsWith is not a function' and blanked the journey form — mappers are now string-guarded and array-aware, with a unit test
reference arrays modelled as object lists saved related: [{}], which Zod refused — now plain slug lists
the settings singleton renders as one collapsed 'Settings' group (the JSON nests under its id) — one click to open; noted in the cheat sheet
build: scripts/build.mjs runs `tinacms build` only when TINA_PUBLIC_CLIENT_ID and TINA_TOKEN are set, then `astro build`; Cloudflare deploys keep working without credentials
gate: OPEN — the M7 gate is the owner's own dashboard session, which needs a Tina Cloud project (CLIENT_REVIEW_SHEET §26). Everything the session exercises is proven locally.
docs: EXECUTION_RUNBOOK M7 step 2 superseded (forms, not visual)
